room.idempotency_key: UUID retained by the caller for the exact reviewed action, including uncertain retries
room.scope: Server-derived session key and actor slug
room.payload_binding: Durable partner_room_turn row compares room, sponsor, seat, kind, body and origin attribution before replay
room.replay: Original seq, at and message identity; no duplicate append; no time bucket
room.key_reuse: HTTP 409 when the same scoped key names different material

concurrency: Version locked and compared inside the writer transaction; mismatch is version_conflict before replacement; no silent rebase
receipt_recovery: Same-key serialization and original envelope receipt lookup precede the expected-version check
consumer_order: Update the consumer to retain operation identity and send the reviewed fresh version before enabling the producer's required fields
